tours.title: Four days that show you Oman
tours.lead: Every tour is private and can be reshaped around you. Start with one of these, or mix them.
tours.mapFallback: Map of northern Oman showing the four tour routes

muscat-city.name: Muscat city
muscat-city.short: Mosque, souq, opera house and the old harbour, at your pace.
muscat-city.seoDescription: A private Muscat city tour in your language: Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque, Mutrah Souq and Corniche, the Royal Opera House and Old Muscat. Hotel pickup included.
muscat-city.intro: The capital in one unhurried day: marble and chandeliers at the Grand Mosque, frankincense smoke in Mutrah Souq, and the quiet palaces of Old Muscat by the sea.
muscat-city.duration: Half day or full day, 5 to 8 hours

stops.name: Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque
stops.note: Open to visitors most mornings. Modest dress required, abayas available.

stops.name: Royal Opera House Muscat
stops.note: Walk the gardens and galleries. Tours inside when there is no rehearsal.

stops.name: Mutrah Corniche and Souq
stops.note: Frankincense, silver, halwa and a coffee with a harbour view.

stops.name: Old Muscat and Al Alam Palace
stops.note: Photo stop at the palace gates, the forts and Bait Al Zubair museum.

included: Hotel pickup and drop-off in Muscat
Entry tickets listed in the plan

nizwa-mountains.name: Nizwa and the mountains
nizwa-mountains.short: The old capital, a Friday cattle market and the cool green terraces of the Hajar.
nizwa-mountains.seoTitle: Nizwa and Jebel Akhdar Private Tour
nizwa-mountains.seoDescription: A private day trip from Muscat to Nizwa Fort and Souq, the abandoned village of Birkat Al Mouz and the terraces of Jebel Akhdar, guided in your language.
nizwa-mountains.intro: Inland Oman in a day: the round tower of Nizwa Fort, a souq that has traded for centuries, and a climb into the Hajar mountains where roses and pomegranates grow on terraces.
nizwa-mountains.bestTime: Friday for the cattle market, all year in the mountains

stops.name: Nizwa Fort and Souq
stops.note: Climb the tower, then walk the pottery, dates and silver souqs.

stops.name: Birkat Al Mouz
stops.note: Mud-brick ruins and a working falaj irrigation channel among the palms.

stops.name: Jebel Akhdar plateau
stops.note: Terraced villages at 2000 m. Cooler air, wide views.

stops.name: Bahla Fort (optional)
stops.note: A UNESCO World Heritage site, if time and energy allow.

included: Hotel pickup and drop-off in Muscat

wahiba-desert.name: Wahiba desert
wahiba-desert.short: Wadi Bani Khalid by day, red dunes at sunset, a night under the stars.
wahiba-desert.seoDescription: A private overnight trip to the Wahiba Sands (Sharqiya Sands) with a swim in Wadi Bani Khalid, dune driving, sunset and a desert camp, guided in your language.
wahiba-desert.intro: Turquoise pools in a palm-filled wadi, then the sand: dune driving with an experienced desert driver, a sunset from the crest, and dinner and a night in a desert camp.

stops.name: Wadi Bani Khalid
stops.note: Swim in the pools. Bring swimwear and something to cover up.

stops.name: Al Wasil and the edge of the sands
stops.note: Tyre pressure down, then into the dunes.

stops.name: Sunset dune
stops.note: The best light of the trip. Sandboarding if you want it.

stops.name: Desert camp
stops.note: Dinner, stars and a quiet night. Breakfast before the drive back.

included: Hotel pickup and drop-off in Muscat
Camp night with dinner and breakfast

wadi-shab-coast.name: Wadi Shab and the coast
wadi-shab-coast.short: A hike and swim into a hidden cave, the Bimmah sinkhole and white beaches.
wadi-shab-coast.seoTitle: Wadi Shab and Bimmah Sinkhole Private Tour
wadi-shab-coast.seoDescription: A private coastal day trip from Muscat to the Bimmah Sinkhole, Fins beach and Wadi Shab with its hike, pools and cave waterfall, guided in your language.
wadi-shab-coast.intro: The coast road south of Muscat: a swim in the Bimmah Sinkhole, a white beach at Fins, then the walk and swim up Wadi Shab to a waterfall inside a cave.

stops.name: Bimmah Sinkhole
stops.note: Steps down to green-blue water. Bring swimwear.

stops.name: Fins beach
stops.note: White sand, clear water, almost no one there.

stops.name: Wadi Shab
stops.note: A short boat crossing, a 45 minute hike, then swim to the cave.

stops.name: Sur (optional)
stops.note: The dhow yard and the lighthouse, if you want a longer day.

included: Hotel pickup and drop-off in Muscat

items.q: How much does a private tour cost?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Prices depend on the tour, the group size and the season. Send your dates and group size on WhatsApp and you get a clear price for the whole group, with no per-head surprises.

items.q: Where do you pick us up?
items.a: Placeholder answer. From any hotel, apartment or cruise terminal in Muscat. Pickup from other cities can be arranged.
Placeholder answer. Muscat city is a half or full day, Nizwa and Wadi Shab are full days, and the Wahiba desert is an overnight trip. Every tour can be shortened or extended.

items.q: Which languages do you guide in?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Arabic plus English, Spanish, Italian, German, French, Chinese, Portuguese, Catalan, Russian, Korean, Japanese and Hindi. Mixed-language groups are welcome.

items.q: How big can the group be?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Tours are private, from one traveler up to six in one vehicle. Larger groups can travel with a second vehicle.

items.q: How do we book and pay?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Message on WhatsApp or send the request form. A small deposit secures the date and the rest is paid on the day.
